description: How can giant pieces of masonry be moved by hand without animal or engineering assistance?  This puzzle has been investigated by researchers inspired by the conclusions for how the Moai on Rapanui were moved from the quarry to their final resting positions. It has been demonstrated that the movement of Moai up to 82 tonnes in mass was possible by rocking the Moai and slowly ‘walking’ them.  Is this a method used by other ancient cultures for moving large stones? Large concrete blocks have been developed whereby they are given a lowered centre of gravity and a base that allows free movement.  Reportedly concrete blocks up to 25 tonnes in weight have been moved by a single person. Potentially the blocks may be used in places where access for heavy lifing gear is difficult.  Additionally the structures are both easily built and disassembled for potential reuse.   #stone #survey #expert #advice #architecture #heritage #masonry #history #foryou #fyp #foryoupage
